([[Temecula, California]]) | college = [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]] (2019–2022) | highlights = *First-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] ([[2021–22 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|2022]]) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2019 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2019]]) }} '''Eric Isaiah Mobley''' (born September 24, 1999) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC Trojans]]. He attended Rancho Christian School in [[Temecula, California]], where he was a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]]. He was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] as a junior with USC. ==High school career== Mobley attended Rancho Christian School in [[Temecula, California]]. As a freshman, he won the [[CIF Southern Section]] (CIF-SS) Division 5A title, the school's first in any sport, and led his team to the CIF Division V Southern California Regional final.{{cite web |last1=Negri |first1=Landon |title=Mobley leads Rancho Christian to comeback victory over St. Bernard for first CIF title 23, 2016}} As a sophomore, Mobley was joined on the Rancho Christian basketball team by his younger brother [[Evan Mobley]]. He helped his team reach the CIF-SS Division 2A semifinal.{{cite web |last1=Connolly |first1=Kenny |title=Rancho Christian falls to Capistrano Valley in the Division 2A semifinals |url=https://www.pe.com/2017/02/24/rancho-christian-falls-to-capistrano-valley-in-the-division-2a-semifinals/ |website=[[The Press-Enterprise]] |accessdate=July 25, 2019 |date=February 24, 2017}} In
